description:
KVK branch profile

Returns the KVK Handelsregister branch profile for a 12-digit branch number.
Fields follow KVK: `vestigingsnummer`, `kvkNummer`, `eersteHandelsnaam`,
`indHoofdvestiging`, `handelsnamen`, `adressen`, `websites`,
`sbiActiviteiten`. Current data is always fetched from KVK (local cache:
48 hours). `lastFetchedAt` shows the last retrieval date.

Cost: 2 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kvk.detail.branch
